thread:
Maria P.: sorry team — family emergency, need to hand off primary tonight. I have to leave in ~30m. Can anyone take primary from 18:30–02:00 PST? :wave:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT 5230 detected — embed-serving error-rate spike. Paging primary: @Maria P. (ack required).
Maria P.: acked the page, I started a triage but I need to step out. Errors are 5xx from embed workers, ~12% of requests failing, latency up ~400ms. Customer impact = degraded search relevance for a subset of tenants.
Dan K.: I can cover primary starting 18:30 PST. Quick question — is this already P1? I see alert group "embed.high-error-rate" firing.
Maria P.: currently P2 but trending P1, escalated to oncall because of user-facing errors. Runbook here: https://redwood.runbooks/embed-failure (scroll to "Primary Handoff / Immediate Mitigation"). Key steps in my notes below.
Alex R.: Dan — FYI the HA failover steps are in the runbook. Short checklist: 1) Verify alerts in Grafana, 2) Check worker queue lag, 3) Restart embed-consumer service on one node, 4) If still failing, roll back recent model deploy.
Sam T.: If you take primary, make sure to update PagerDuty assignment and Slack status. Command we use in infra to mark takeover: ```/rotation takeover --primary @DanK --from @MariaP --until 2026-03-15T02:00Z```
Jo L.: Also add a note in the incident doc: https://redwood.incidents/5230 — mention handoff and owner change.
Dan K.: taking primary. Will run through checklist now. First actions: fetch recent error traces and confirm whether a single model or infra.
Dan K.: (running) `kubectl -n embed get pods -l app=embed-consumer -o wide` — one pod OOM recently, logs show repeated "out of memory" during batch step.
Maria P.: thanks Dan — if it looks like OOM, the temporary mitigation is to reduce batch_size on deploy config and restart the consumer, then monitor error-rate for 10m. Full mitigation path is scaled in runbook.
Alex R.: reminder: if we do restart and errors persist, trigger fallback routing to smaller model variant. Policy located in Console -> Model Routing -> embed_model_v2 -> fallback: embed_model_v1.
Dan K.: updated PagerDuty assignment, changed Slack status to "oncall (primary)". Will attempt reduced batch_size restart in 5m.
Sam T.: handoff checklist (quick): - confirm PD assignment - update incident doc - share runbook section link - leave note in thread with restart commands - confirm handback time
Dan K.: done restart with `kubectl rollout restart deploy/embed-consumer --namespace embed`. Watching metrics now.
oncall-bot: Alert "embed.high-error-rate" status: still firing (severity: high).
Dan K.: seeing improvement in errors (5xx down from 12% to ~3%), latency trending down. Will hold as primary for the window. Maria — take care, ping me if you need anything.
Maria P.: thank you so much Dan. Leaving the remaining mitigation steps in the runbook section below. Appreciate the cover. :heart:
Jo L.: tagging SRE for visibility: @Alex R., @Sam T. if we need infra scaling during night.
Dan K.: leaving a quick runbook excerpt here for whoever follows: ```ImmediateMitigation:
- Check Grafana panel: Embed Errors / Latency
- Reduce consumer batch_size to 8 in config (service: embed-consumer)
- Restart embed-consumer pods one at a time
- If errors persist, switch routing to embed_model_v1 via Console
- Notify affected customers via status.redwood.ai if >10% impacted
```
Maria P.: last note — I'm reachable by phone, but otherwise I'm offline. Thanks again. :pray:
notes: handoff during active incident; primary reassigned to Dan K.; mitigation steps started; runbook link included
